t: Business Applications Analyst (Customer Success and Support)
content: ...esolve bugs and incidents quickly. - Document clearly. Write functional specifications, process flows, and user stories for the changes you deliver. - Test before you ship. Run and document UAT, and support peer reviews before anything reaches production. - Keep tickets moving. Manage your queue of requests and simple projects, track progress, and share regular updates with stakeholders. - Handle vendors day to day. Raise and track support tickets, follow up on SLAs, and escalate recurring problems. - Enable the teams. Train CX and CS colleagues on new tools and processes, and keep documentation current. WHAT YOU’LL BRING - 3–5 years in business applications, systems administration, or a CX or CS operations role with a strong systems focus. - Hands-on admin experience with at least one support or customer success platform, such as Freshworks, Zendesk, HubSpot Service Hub, Gainsight, or Vitally. - A working knowledge of how support and customer success teams operate, including ticket lifecycles, SLAs, escalations, onboarding, health scoring, and renewals. - Comfort with data: properties, fields, reports, and dashboards. You can spot when something doesn’t add up. - Clear written and spoken English. You’ll work with teams across Europe every day. - A curious, service-minded approach. You ask why before you build. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with CRM integrations or data flows between support tools and a CRM. - Exposure to AI agents or automation in support, such as chatbots and ticket deflection. - Relevant certifications in HubSpot, Freshworks, or a CS platform. - Experience in a SaaS or fintech company.
